notes: Account: mid-stage enterprise financial data platform; heavy compliance and residency needs.
Buying group: Head of Search (Dir), Head of Infra (VP), Security/Legal, Procurement.
Primary ask: reliable embeddings + reranking pipeline that scales to tens of millions of indexed documents with predictable tail latency and clear cost per query math.
Quote from Dir of Search: "Need sub-120ms 95th percentile for top-k retrieval + reranking at 200 QPS peak or we keep costs in-house.",
Prefers open connector options: pgvector for on-prem and Postgres-backed tenants; Pinecone for cloud-managed; wants ability to swap providers behind routing policy.
Model preferences: experimenting with 768-d and 1536-d embeddings; interested in quantized reranker models for cost reduction and deterministic fallbacks.
Data shape: 50M docs, avg doc length 1.2k tokens, metadata-heavy (account IDs, time, sensitivity tags).
Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query (emb+rerank) < $0.005 at median; budget scenarios for 200–500 QPS bursts explored.
Ops: needs connector that supports incremental upserts, metadata filtering, hybrid sparse+dense scoring, and chunk-level provenance for audits.
Security: must support VPC peering for Pinecone or private deployment; SSO for console; HSM/KMS integration for key management; 7-year audit log retention requested for certain records.
Technical note from SE: HNSW tuning required for 50M vectors; shard sizing and disk I/O on pgvector will dominate tail latency without caching/KV prefix reuse.
They ran a baseline pilot on Elastic Cloud: good recall but high cost & worse throughput vs vector DB; looking for predictable unit economics.
Open questions: how Redwood Optimize recommendations map to connector-specific params (ef/search_k, M, index_type), and what prebuilt connectors we provide vs custom.
Customer risk: vendor-lock concerns, wants exportable vector snapshots and an on-prem option for regulated workstreams.
Decision timeline: POC results due by mid-April; procurement/contracting in May if POC shows 95p latency <120ms and ARR math holds.

use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG/search: embeddings-first retrieval + neural reranker on returned candidates. Need hybrid search (BM25 + dense), low tail latency, and transparent cost per query. Vector DB connector flexibility required (pgvector for on-prem, Pinecone/Weaviate for cloud).
requirements: Index scale: target 50M vectors first phase, 200M+ roadmap
Throughput: sustain 200 QPS steady-state, 500 QPS burst
Connector features: incremental upsert, chunk-level metadata filtering, batched ingest, low-latency read path, snapshot/export
Ops: KMS/HSM, VPC peering, SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 7y, SOC2 attestation
Model routing: fallback to smaller embedding dims or quantized reranker under capacity pressure
connector_requirements: Incremental sync with conflict resolution; support upsert by external_id
Batched ingest API with backpressure and monitoring hooks
Metadata-aware filtering and tag-based ACLs at query time
Support for hybrid queries: BM25 + dense score merge or plugin reranker hook
Efficient snapshot/export to portable format (parquet + vectors) for vendor migration
TTL and retention policies compatible with legal hold
Auth: token rotation + ability to use customer-managed service account / IAM
poC_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): index 5M sample docs into pgvector using Redwood pipeline; measure 95p retrieval latency and cost/Q
Phase 2 (2 weeks): replicate same index into Pinecone; compare latency, recall, and unit economics under 200 QPS
Phase 3 (1 week): run reranking models (quantized) on top-k and validate latency SLOs; validate fallback routing between providers
Deliverables: perf matrix (95/50/median latencies), cost-per-query estimate, configuration recommendations for Optimize
